[[Category:Beulah Cemetery, Nuckolls County, Nebraska]]
== Biography ==
His record in FindAGrave has an obituary attached. It says he was a veteran of the Civil War (65th Ohio Infantry), had eight children, was born in Guersey County, Ohio, married in 1869, and lived in Page County, Iowa, and Platte County, Nebraska. He died in Nuckolls County, Nebraska.

According to the 1880 census, he was born in Ohio and both of his parents were born in Ireland.
